title: Pointer to the properties of etale cohomology
text:
In the notation of [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], the following holds. The
existence of the resolutions used here is
[prop-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions-exist], and the independence of the
groups from the chosen resolution is
[prop-weil-pbc-cohomology-resolution-independent].
